QuestInfo.name: Verifying the Farm Situation
QuestInfo.0: #p1013101# seems worried that the number of #o9300385#es has grown. Talk to #p1013101#.
QuestInfo.1: #p1013101# says that he is worried whether the number of foxes in the #b#m100030300##k has also grown. He asks that you go to #bDad#k and ask him about the situation. If the number of foxes has grown, some major hunting may be required...
QuestInfo.2: Dad seems to be more worried about the #o1210100#s than the #o9300385#es.

0.0: If the number of foxes has increased near the farm just like it has near our house, that'll interfere with Dad's farm work. We should investigate this. Don't you agree?

yes.0: Go to the #b#m100030300##k and ask #bDad#k about the situation. If the number of #o9300385#es has increased there as well, we're going to have to conduct a major #o9300385# hunt.

no.0: What? Think hard about this! If the farm fails, what are we going to survive on! Huh? Talk to me again and press ACCEPT this time!

1.0: What is it, Evan? I'm sure you're not here to deliver another #t4032448#, and I'm too busy to play with you... What? Have the number of foxes increased here?

yes.0: Well, I'm not sure. I've been too busy to notice. The #b#o1210100##ks have been acting crazy, jumping all over the place. Even the foxes seem to be running away from the #o1210100#s...
yes.1: Ah, maybe that is why the #o9300385# population near the house has increased. They ran there to escape from the #o1210100#s. Hmm...

npc.0: You haven't talked to Dad yet? You didn't forget where he is, right? #bDad#k is at the #b#m100030300##k. Come on! Get your act together!
